title: Auditor Holle
kicker: a collections agent with a smile that never reaches the ledger
hook: a collections agent with a smile that never reaches the ledger

blocks.label: Public Read
blocks.body: A red-violet infernis auditor in immaculate black-and-bronze robes holds a dark ledger against her chest, seal ribbons and oath-medallions hanging from her collar like little verdicts.

blocks.label: Comes Across As
blocks.body: Immaculate calm built as a wall against her own memory of once needing mercy. Polishes a closed-eye page weight before she speaks. Insists cruelty is merely inefficient, which is its own quiet kind of confession.

blocks.label: Might Offer
blocks.body: A way forward A grounded question A scene-specific clue seed
